pages.text: An Isotope Shard is a rare sliver of isotope recovered from spent fuel. It is the seed of the $(l)Fusion Crystal$() at the heart of every $(l:mech/mech_core)Mech Core$(/l).

$(li)$(l)Get it$(): the $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l) recovers one from $(l)1 Depleted Fuel Rod in 4$().$(br)$(li)$(l)Use it$(): the Crystallizer grows it into a Fusion Crystal. See $(l:mech/mech_core)Mech Core$(/l).
